# SportDharma Ecosystem

> Sovereign, offline-first, and open-source technology designed for extreme outdoor resilience, athletic autonomy, and edge AI analytics.

## About
SportDharma Ecosystem is an independent, open-source (FOSS) project created to provide robust technological infrastructure for athletes, cyclists, and explorers operating in environments with zero or intermittent cloud connectivity. By replacing traditional cloud-dependent architectures with local-first processing (*Edge AI* and local SLMs), the ecosystem guarantees absolute data sovereignty and continuous operational safety.

## Core Pillars & Architecture
- **SportDharma App**: Offline mapping, telemetry, and critical path telemetry running directly on mobile devices without external API dependency.
- **Edge AI & Local Intelligence**: Localized processing of biometric variables and geospatial data leveraging embedded frameworks (Flutter, SQLite, LiteRT-LM).
- **Network Resilience**: Designed for low-bandwidth environments, integrating autonomous node logic and sovereign field management.

## Project Status & Funding
- **Current Stage**: Early Stage infrastructure consolidation and FOSS architecture deployment.
- **Grant Application**: Active submission and alignment under EU open-source frameworks (NGI / NLnet) to foster decentralized, privacy-first public digital infrastructure.
